title: Larkwell Copilot: what failed overnight?
about: A ~20-second teaser. Invented product, company, systems and data (see README).

scenes.vo: It's month-end, and the interface queue is red.

scenes.sub: It reads the logs and shows its sources.

blocks.text: Which inbound invoices failed in BP1 overnight, and why?

blocks.lead: Three inbound invoices failed after 02:00. All three name the same vendor, which does not exist in `BP1` yet.

scenes.vo: Ask Larkwell Copilot what failed. It reads the logs, finds the common cause, and shows where every line came from.
Larkwell Copilot. Answers from your own systems.
